note: Core optimization bounds bracket the empirical mean minimum oscillation at size h+1; the orange curve uses feasible upper endpoints. Sampling bands are approximate and pointwise. Floating-point combinatorial optimization, not outward transcendental certificates.

ensemble_bound.note: Population expected absolute-error upper bound, uniform over graph size; numerical quadrature, not outward certification. No fitted normalization.

absolute_lower_bound.source: manuscript.tex, thm:lower-sharp-rms (finite-depth formula) and proof of lem:lone
absolute_lower_bound.note: Population expected absolute-error lower bound on the specified finite tree. Cutoffs and both truncations are searched separately at every h; no fitted normalization or sampled inputs. The available levels and root-tail split are optimized for each certificate, without claiming global optimality over all certificates. Floating-point quadrature, not outward certification.
